senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Og, king of Bashan.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 42:8">Gen. R. s. 42</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 14:13">Gen. XIV, 13</cite>) <he>הוא ע׳ הוא פליט</he> Og is the one that escaped; Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 25.
<cite ref="Berakhot 54a:14">Ber. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>אבן … לזרוק ע׳ וכ׳</he> the stone which Og king of Bashan wanted to cast upon Israel.
